title: althaea arbelensis
intro: Althaea arbelensis, commonly known as the Palestinian marshmallow, is a plant species in the mallow family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing, skin conditions, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Althaea arbelensis are attributed to its soothing and protective effects on mucous membranes, and it is also believed to have antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include mucilages, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
